about: Sanitized regression contracts for bad cases reported by the site owner or discovered while reviewing production trajectories. An AQ id preserves trajectory provenance when available; older screenshot-only reports use a REPORTED id. Raw trajectories stay in Cloudflare and are not committed. Offline tests check deterministic routing, retrieval scope, and resource delivery. The live eval also checks model answers and optional latency budgets. Cases marked open are still measured and reported, but remain expected failures until their fix lands.

cases.title: A resume reply rendered a broken prose link and a duplicate attachment
cases.regression: The model wrote a malformed resume URL in prose while the frontend also rendered the same PDF as a resource card.

cases.title: A token question returned a dashboard link and repeated the resume
cases.regression: The answer described where token data lived instead of returning the live number, then leaked the prior turn's resume card into the response.

cases.regression: When the Mac was unavailable, the cloud planner response was coerced to [object Object]. The agent produced no usable plan and only succeeded because the fixed QA pipeline recovered.

cases.title: A leadership interview question missed the flagship project
cases.regression: Without an explicit project name, the agent retrieved a classroom project, said no professional example was documented and missed Agentic Hiring. Adding a parenthetical naming Agentic Hiring immediately produced the right answer.
